mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 exceeding 2% YoY signals strengthening aggregate demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 YoY growth > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained FEDFUNDS rate below 3.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 4.5% and PAYEMS growth exceeds 150,000 jobs per month, a tightening labor market signals positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO exceeding 1.2% MoM signals strengthening industrial production, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in RSAFS below $300,000 million signals reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 55% of quarters with RSAFS below $300,000 million.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.2% and CPIAUCSL growth slows below 2% YoY, a monetary policy-driven slowdown signals negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: PAYEMS growth exceeding 100,000 jobs per month signals a strong labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.015 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in HOUST exceeding 5% YoY signals strengthening housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but only during mid-cycle expansions.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of mid-cycle quarters with HOUST YoY growth > 5%.
